commitResults.messageTitle: Accept only English letters in names
commitResults.messageBody:
Student and guardian names accepted letters from any language, but
TutorReach is meant to take English names only.

Let's accept only English letters, and compare only the letters of
names when checking for duplicate students.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: align guardian editing behavior in DG
commitResults.messageBody:
Update the editstudent implementation description to reflect that an existing guardian's name and phone can be edited independently.

Replace the outdated manual test that rejected a name-only edit with a valid one-field guardian edit scenario, and clarify the rules for adding and removing guardians.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge pull request #173 from LINGSIHAN/docs/fix-independent-guardian-edit-dg
commitResults.messageBody: Update DG for independent guardian detail edits

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand supported name punctuation
commitResults.messageBody:
Some legitimate Singapore names use aliases, initials, parentheses, or
suffix punctuation beyond the formats TutorReach accepts.

Let's expand name validation to accept more common punctuation in valid
positions, and document and test the supported formats.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for name punctuation validation
Merge pull request #175 from LINGSIHAN/v1.6/allow-common-name-punctuation
commitResults.messageBody: Support aliases and common punctuation in names

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix lesson card text wrapping
commitResults.messageBody:
Lesson list cells size themselves to their content, causing long lesson
and enrolled-student names to extend beyond the panel width.

Let's size lesson cells to the list width so their existing wrapping
labels display complete names without horizontal scrolling.
